title: THE LINE
meaning: Boundary, morality, loyalty, intimacy and ultimately choice.

title: STAY
meaning: Jiwon's language of protection gradually becomes the language of voluntary presence.

title: TRUTH
meaning: Taeyun begins by treating truth as a weapon and ends by surrendering control over what others do with it.

title: HANDS
meaning: Violence becomes restraint, restraint becomes touch, and touch becomes choice.

title: NAMES
meaning: Aegis and Architect gradually give way to Jiwon and Taeyun.

title: SAVING
meaning: The difference between protecting someone and choosing for them.

title: THE OBSERVATORY
meaning: The one place in Vesper where neither HALO nor Eclipse gets to define who they are.
